confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer estimates use broad recent city-price ranges; the available crowd-sourced city table has no recent entries, so the ranges are not precise. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and are estimated from a shared local drink-price reference and their relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge; seasonal demand and limited local supply can move them substantially.
comparable_city_reasoning: A remote, seasonal Patagonia gateway town with strong glacier-tourism demand; food and lodging estimates allow for higher visitor prices than larger Argentine cities, while the accommodation figures remain general estimates.
